status: Prepared internal set after user request for some PubMed-data questions; not yet evaluated
selection_rule: Seven unchanged released MedQA training cases plus three primary-trial numerical/outcome questions, selected before new inference. Do not select on model success/failure.

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What diagnosis best explains new watery diarrhea during antibiotic treatment?
selection.support_note: Antibiotic exposure and compatible diarrhea; supports the differential, not a confirmed diagnosis without testing.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.topic: Positional chest pain and a friction rub
selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What diagnosis fits chest pain relieved by leaning forward and a friction rub?
selection.support_note: Classic pericarditis findings; the older guideline supports these findings, not a claim to current comprehensive management.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What best explains galactorrhea with elevated TSH and prolactin?
selection.support_note: Supports hypothyroidism-associated hyperprolactinemia; also inspect the medication distractor rather than ignoring it.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What immediate management step is appropriate for a cold weak leg in a patient with atrial fibrillation?
selection.support_note: Supports immediate unfractionated heparin while urgent revascularization is assessed; heparin alone is not definitive limb rescue.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What is the next step in labor after a previous newborn had invasive GBS disease?
selection.support_note: Previous GBS-infected newborn is an indication for intrapartum prophylaxis; penicillin is the preferred agent when applicable.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: What immediate treatment is appropriate at 32 weeks with severe hypertension, headaches and low platelets?
selection.support_note: Supports magnesium sulfate consideration and immediate antihypertensive therapy; stabilization does not settle delivery timing.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.discussion_summary_not_generation_input: Which agent reverses excess unfractionated heparin in this case?
selection.support_note: Label indication supports protamine for heparin overdose; no dose is derived from the vignette.
selection.tool_use: Hypothesis to appraise; no fixed requirement to search

selection.question_origin: Project-authored source-specific fact question; no official examination-board label
selection.retrieval_hypothesis: Finding the original trial abstract can substantiate exact results; actual benefit must be measured, not presumed
selection.reference_note: Main trial, not its pilot or subgroup publications. Noninferiority is not superiority; limits include exclusion of severe immunosuppression and S. aureus bloodstream infection.

selection.question_origin: Project-authored source-specific fact question; no official examination-board label
selection.retrieval_hypothesis: Finding the original trial abstract can substantiate exact results; actual benefit must be measured, not presumed
selection.reference_note: Use the original randomized trial, not later subgroup analyses. Distinguish DVT from pulmonary embolism and noninferior mortality from equality of every outcome.

selection.question_origin: Project-authored source-specific fact question; no official examination-board label
selection.retrieval_hypothesis: Finding the original trial abstract can substantiate exact results; actual benefit must be measured, not presumed
selection.reference_note: Oral SOUL trial, not subcutaneous SELECT/FLOW or pooled meta-analysis. Primary cardiovascular result does not establish improvement in every secondary kidney outcome.

limitations: Named-trial cases assess locating/reading a specific study rather than broad unprompted discovery
Training/existing-literature memorization and ceiling effects remain possible
Not an external benchmark; point 4 uses separate MedQA test questions
per_case_hash_definition: SHA-256 of complete current generation input, including IC question_id, serialized with json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False). Previous candidate hashes refer to earlier CP IDs.
